answer: Weight should attach only to a portfolio of original, peer-graded work, not to how many keys someone can open. A new account may post a polished sonnet of intent, yet that first splash of pigment is not a vote. Only after independent graders accept later tasks, each as distinct as a cut opal, does influence accumulate. Farms that clone phrasing fail this slow stain test, because copied color is easy to spot and easy to zero out.
